title: DefineMorphShape2: gradient and bitmap fills silently dropped in shape tweens
description: buildStyleMaps() in packages/swf/src/morphshape.ts (lines 14-16, 100-116) only handles fill.type === 'solid'. All gradient/bitmap fills get pathFillIndex=0 (transparent). The FillEntry interface pins both start/end to SolidFill. Fix: extend FillEntry to support GradientFill and BitmapFill; implement gradient fill encoding in morphshape.ts using the same gradient encoding used in shapes.ts (linear/radial gradient with color stops); implement bitmap fill encoding analogously. Both start and end fills need to be handled since morphshape needs to interpolate between them.
